key_provisions_or_claims: Sets objectives and 13 principles for AI development and use, including human oversight, non-discrimination, transparency and accountability
Grants affected individuals rights to prior information, explanation, contestation, human participation and non-discrimination
Defines AI system, provider, operator and user
Requires high-risk AI oversight measures, cybersecurity protocols, incident response plans and staff training
Provides for liability, compensation for damages and sanctions
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 1465/2024 (Dep. Júnior Mano) setting principles, rights and duties for developing and using AI in Brazil. It provides rights to explanation, contestation and human oversight, risk-based obligations for high-risk systems, incident response, liability and sanctions. It contains no robot-specific provisions.
annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 1465/2024 - Estabelece princípios, garantias, direitos e deveres para o desenvolvimento, a implementação e a aplicação da inteligência artificial no Brasil
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1465/2024 - Establishing principles, guarantees, rights and duties for the development, implementation and application of artificial intelligence in Brazil
